children: QBE Insurance could find it hard to sustain its combined operating ratio into 2027, UBS analyst Kieren Chidgey warns. He tells clients in a note that the Australia-listed insurer is still showing strong top-line momentum, but points out that its combined operating ratio guidance of 92.5% remains unchanged despite support from below-allowance catastrophe costs and reserve releases. Chidgey sees 93.3% as a more realistic combined operating ratio for 2027, while consensus sits at 92.7%. UBS keeps a neutral rating on the stock and raises its target price 5.9% to 26.75 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.5% at A$26.625. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
